text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament MC
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the 38th Fishing Cup 
officially begins! Best of luck to all our 
participants!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Geh, absolutely nothing is biting! Are 
there even fish in here?! Urrgh...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know☆ Hey hey, Ai-chan♡ Let's change 
spots! You haven't caught anything either, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's true... 
But I think I'll stick it out just a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“Huh? Really? Why's that? 
Wouldn't it be better to change spots 
aggressively?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“No, I don't think rushing will do us any 
good. 
—Winning in the end is all that matters. 
Let's wait it out patiently.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Oh boy, she's completely in serious mode 
now. 
Sei-chan might not want to take things too 
easy, huh?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“*gulp, gulp*... Phew! Lunch break's over! 
I wonder which spot I should aim for this 
afternoon...”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Hey, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“So, um... correct me if I'm wrong, but... 
...Did you figure something out?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Rather than figuring it out, it's more 
like it just clicked for me. 
But, yeah... hehe. I feel like I 
understand a little better now.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“What resting really means. 
And what kind of 'rest' makes for time 
well-spent for me.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Um... would you mind telling me? 
What clicked, and how?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Of course! It's pretty much something 
Bright-san taught me anyway—”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“We tend to think of resting as 'coming to 
a halt,' right? 
Except that's not it. It really isn't.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Resting is 'easing up your pace'... 
In truth, even while resting, you're 
steadily advancing, little by little. 
Toward your destination.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “I see...? ...Yeah, yeah...”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that makes so much sense.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“It's the same with manga! First, you 
sketch out the storyboards on pure 
momentum! And then— 
you leave it alone. The next day, a calmer 
version of yourself looks it over with a 
critical eye!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“That's how you make something 
interesting. Stepping away from your work 
to look at it objectively is essential... 
Yeah. So rest is—”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“It's 'revision'! 
A step to help me draw the ultimate 
story!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“I get it... I totally get it now! If 
resting is just 
one of the 'necessary steps' to creating a 
masterpiece—”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: TAKE THIIIIIS!!

text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament MC
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa! And there goes Kiseki-san reeling 
in her 40th fish! 
The showdown between our top contenders is 
heating up!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Ngh... To think that just a change in 
mindset 
could make this much of a difference...!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ai-chan. For telling me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Thanks to you, I can tackle 'playing 
around' with everything I've got! 
I'm finally resting properly!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —With this, I can beat Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“...! ...Hehe. Did you ask me for advice 
earlier, Kiseki-chan, 
just because you wanted to beat me?”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“...Ahaha. It's totally pathetic, I know!! 
Really not main character material at 
all... ugh...”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“...But still. 
Back then, I made up my mind.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“To catch up to you, who is always ahead 
of me. 
To Almond Eye, who fits the role of 
protagonist so much better than I do—”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That no matter what it takes, I'm going to 
catch up to you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“...Hehe. In that case, I'll just have to 
take the lead right back from you.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Hehe... Now, taste this—behold my 
'Wide Tornado Casting'ーーー!!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“What kind of special move is that?! 
...No, not yet! 
I still have my lead from the first half!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Bring it on, Almond Eye! 
Today, I'm taking a win from you!!”

text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament MC
text_block_list.text:
“And so, our winner is Seiun Sky-san!! 
As a supplementary prize, she will be 
awarded seaweed harvested from the local 
waters!”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, thanks~ It's your girl, Sei-chan. 
Yay☆

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Eye
text_block_list.text:
“S-So frustratingーーー!! 
Ugh, it's so frustrating...!!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Man, that was frustrating! But it was 
super fun! 
How long has it been since I played around 
so seriously?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“Fufu, that is wonderful to hear~. It 
seems both of you 
were able to have a meaningful rest~.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Yes! So—tomorrow as well! 
Please hang out and take a breather with 
us again!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“So that I can become someone who wins 
even more this summer— 
I want to give it my all, both in training 
and resting!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“I'm so glad I relied on Sky-senpai and 
Bright-senpai~. 
Actually, maybe relying on you senpais 
proves I'm a genius~☆”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“Well then, well then! See ya tomorrow! 
Let's meet up outside the lodge tomorrow! 
And do something☆”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Hehe. What do you mean by 'something'? 
We should probably decide what we're doing 
in advance—”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“............? Lady Sky? 
Is something the matter~?”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“...Hm? Ah, no, not really? 
Just—”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thinking about how everyone is so earnest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Hm, a phone call? ...From President 
Rudolf?! 
Hello! ...Yes. Yes... —Huh?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“A mock race? ...Against the President and 
the others!!?”
